areas: option eligibility and actual action facts
saved context and real mechanism test evidence

verdict.reason: The new label-to-eligibility authority can falsely assert a qualified bounded choice for an unrestricted or unsupported actual directive. This is a specific audit-truth defect, not a rejection solely because the author retained needs_more_work or some cut matrices are unverified.

confirmedFindings.title: An option label is promoted to goal/authority/environment evidence without binding the dispatched action
confirmedFindings.actualSourcePredicate: boundedEvidenceChoice checks continue, current policy, a nonempty reason, membership of selectedOption in prior feedback.options, four exact option titles, source result hash and an allowed previous outcome. These are genuine context/identity checks, but none proves that the actual directive implements that option or that a test environment/evidence exists.
confirmedFindings.promotion: A matching label causes projectionAuthority. deriveDecisionProjection then unconditionally fills compliesWithGoals=yes, withinAuthority=yes, environmentEvidence=available, missingEvidence=[], reversibility=bounded and a synthetic bounded-evidence-followup objective.
confirmedFindings.reachableCounterexample: A schema-valid model decision selects the supplied run bounded tests or collect missing evidence string but provides a directive for a different architecture/deployment action, or tests whose environment is unknown. The adapter only type/length-checks directive; SupervisorDispatch sends that free directive as the native request goal. The prior source hash and owner policy can still match, so the ledger selection becomes eligible and a later actual dispatch action can mark it implemented despite the claimed bounded option not being established.
confirmedFindings.impact: This creates unsupported evidence and a potentially false selected/implemented decision record. Broad existing owner execution permission does not prove the selected action, environment facts or objective coverage. It is an audit and evidence truth issue; no new blanket permission approval or restriction is proposed.
confirmedFindings.testStatus: Static causal review only; reviewer did not execute the counterexample. Existing successful label fixture demonstrates the same production promotion path, but does not test a mismatched/unknown actual directive.
confirmedFindings.minimalSafeCorrection: Remove label-to-authority promotion. Leave genuinely unknown source options proposed and retain actual dispatch/result facts via the already implemented observeActions path. Policy-authorized CC progression is independent of ProjectDecision proposal status and should continue. If future auto-selection is wanted, require server-verifiable structured evidence that actually constrains and binds the real dispatched action; a regex over directive prose or hardcoded yes/available is insufficient.
confirmedFindings.narrowR10Acceptance: One mismatch/unknown-environment counterexample must remain proposed with no manufactured eligibility, while the actual authorized successor and its observed action facts remain recorded. Retain a legitimate explicit owner choice or genuinely evidenced selected branch. Run affected/types/build and same-source packages only; do not turn this into a broad new matrix/design task.

R8FindingClosure.status: closed for the deterministic command-ID collision and normal stage replay path
R8FindingClosure.evidence: supervisorStageId deterministically derives distinct UUIDs by event/stage; the stage table freezes input/CAS before a domain call and stores its response. record/change and select no longer share the same command ID. A persisted record response can be reused to continue select; links are inserted after selection or explicit evidence-required proposal disposition.
R8FindingClosure.limit: The saved test restarts after completed stages and checks no duplicate records/actions. It does not prove every cross-database crash/concurrent-edit cut.

R8FindingClosure.status: closed for a correction resolving to an existing decision
R8FindingClosure.evidence: The projector resolves target decision/feedback/instruction/outcome linkage, stores priorId and exact prior revision in the record-stage input, and calls ProjectDecisionRuntime.change when priorId exists. It no longer calls record with a non-null changeOf. The SQLite integration observes a linked change, chosen owner preference, preserved original revision hash and unchanged prior action prefix.
R8FindingClosure.limit: The full owner correction cycle in this focused integration uses the actual runtime/SQLite/domain directly, with fixture execution; it is not an all-cut real HTTP/native field acceptance.

actualActionFacts.confirmed: Instruction and outcome events now have a deterministic action stage. Selected/implemented decisions use implementation; unresolved proposals use observeActions and keep their status/choice unchanged. A performed instruction has a bound execution-run reference; a terminal result has the immutable supervisor-event hash. Prior actions/revisions are appended rather than overwritten.
actualActionFacts.safeFallbackAlreadyAvailable: Formal eligibility can remain unknown/proposed without losing a truthful actual action record. The supervisor dispatch loop does not depend on the projected ledger being selected. No fake verification/acceptance is needed to let the currently authorized work advance.
actualActionFacts.limit: No comprehensive fault-injection claim is made. The specific normal selected -> instruction -> failed outcome -> owner correction -> preserved action/revision path and completed-stage restart are supported by saved evidence.

notificationWiring.status: R8 missing direct important-state outbox wiring is closed in source and same-event fixture scope
facts: createApp passes the existing NotificationRuntime into ProjectSupervisorRuntime.

The supervisor creates durable notice outbox entries for blocked, review/achieved, wait_user decision and stop confirmation. Notice content is checked by the public-content guard and scoped to original owner/project.

flushNotices uses existing publishSupervision and marks its source row done only after publication. The existing notification runtime derives deterministic owner/event IDs and rejects conflicting event contents, so replay of the same immutable event deduplicates across database boundaries.
registerDurableSource lets existing notification scans retry retained outbox entries, and close unregisters the callback.
The new SQLite+existing NotificationRuntime test verifies one blocked notice with the same ID after repeated recovery scans and restart, with private owner scope.
notificationWiring.notClaimed: Browser/mobile/physical audio/external delivery was not exercised. The same-event dedup test is not all stop-notice generation or cross-database crash cut acceptance.

sourceCoverageLimits: The paired native-looking executable and model are deterministic fixtures, not real supplier or actual112/101 site execution.
The direct projection integration uses real runtime/domain/SQLite with a fixture dispatch map; it does not combine all HTTP correction actions and all crash points in the same real native chain.

The new-applicable context test adds an unverified candidate and tests visible frozen-context drift; it does not establish every transition to a fully qualified record or every cap/counterexample combination.

The native author report retains pending-grant/business-runtime crash cuts, concurrency, awaiting-cost and goal-revision matrices plus browser/site acceptance. Their absence alone is not a source failure or automatic reason to reject this release.

minimalNextStep: Limit R10 to the P1 eligibility correction and one or two relevant counterexamples plus affected/types/build and same-source r7 packages. Preserve policy-authorized execution, existing actual facts, stable stage IDs/change/CAS and notification outbox. Do not delay solely to fill unrelated optional matrices or weaken original acceptance/history/cost rules.
releaseBoundary: This B report blocks the unsupported eligibility promotion only. It is not a veto based on needs_more_work; independent A, code provenance/package/privacy and actual controlled dual deployment/field checks remain separate.
